resources.string: Tigris turns the TV off through its local debugging, which isn\'t answering. It may have been switched off: choose Try Again, and if the TV asks “Allow debugging?”, check “Always allow” and choose Allow.
To turn the TV off from the remote, Tigris needs local debugging, allowed once. After you choose Allow, the TV asks “Allow debugging?”: check “Always allow” and choose Allow.
Couldn\'t turn the TV off from here. Use Power off in the Control Center.
This TV doesn\'t switch inputs from its HDMI keys
Couldn\'t switch to %1$s. Allowing local debugging lets Tigris use the remote\'s input keys.
